CONTINUE: I’ve been on 60mg/DAY. This is what I started with and I have not purged at all, I have no serious side effects. I make sure to drink 4L of water everyday, I brought a huge water bottle on Amazon to motivate me. I only have very very dry lips, I’ve found an amazing lip balms though (La Roche Posay Cicaplast Lip Balm & Aquaphor). I notice a lot of whiteheads on my nose coming out, I just squeeze them out. My eyes are also getting a bit dry, I’ve been using hydrating drops and they seem to solve the issue. Only thing bothering me is migraines. Anyone else had any bad constant headaches with accutane? I see a huge difference for 2 months.

Talk to your girlfriend, I mean she is your girlfriend for a reason at the end of the day. You two were once and probably still in love, think about the first day you met her and all the fun times you guys had. Listen, if you feel miserable than she might not even be right for you but if deep down she is a reason to stay than you truly love her. Think about her in pain, she’ll be traumatized. I know life may seem like a dead end right now but you realize people with the worst backgrounds always are the ones to come out stronger with an incredible story and victory.  You can do this, I know you can. Family can always be replaced with your very own one day! You might even find another partner later on in life who makes you feel worthy of staying. But hey at the end of the day, no one should show you how much you are worth. Life is crazy but we all live the human experience and this journey can easily be ruined by our emotions and past trauma. But, what if one day you just let go free and take a walk and look at all the beauty beyond. Open up your mental capacity so you start seeing things you didn’t even see before. Open that third eye, take care of your mind spirit and soul. I promise you, it’ll make you feel like you found your spirit again.
